newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to start delayed Sofia airport repairs.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to start delayed Sofia airport repairs.

text.p: Bulgarian firm Glavbulgarstroy will start delayed redevelopment work on the capital's run-down airport this month, a senior transport ministry official said on Monday.

The official, who declined to be named, said the construction ministry was expected to approve a contract with Glavbulgarstroy by Wednesday and the firm would start repair work on Sofia airport this month.

Last year Bulgaria dropped France's Campenon Bernard SGE from a $100 million deal to modernise Sofia airport because of disagreements over financial terms, officials said, adding that the firm would supply the airport and its air traffic controllers with equipment.
Reconstruction work, which will not interrupt the airport's operation, includes enlargement of the passenger terminals and lengthening the runway.
